children: US nuclear fuel supplier's Q3 revenue fell 26% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted net loss for Q3 was $9.4 mln, reversing from adjusted net income last year
Company cites lower uranium sales and reduced DOE contract revenue as reasons for revenue decline
Centrus expects 2026 revenue between $450 mln and $500 mln
Company sees 2026 capital deployment of $350 mln to $500 mln
LOWER URANIUM SALES - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to lower volume of uranium sold
DOE CONTRACT REVENUE DROP - Co said Technical Solutions segment revenue fell due to lower revenue from DOE HALEU production contract
WARRANT LIABILITY GAIN - Net income rose due to a gain from fair value adjustment of warrant liabilities and higher investment income
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 12 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the uranium peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Centrus Energy Corp. is $183.00, about 91.3% above its November 3 closing price of $95.67
The stock recently traded at 28 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 60 three months ago
